description: This file is a Python script that sets up and runs a speech-interaction bot using various AI and communication services. It configures audio processing, speech-to-text, language modeling, text-to-speech, and transport mechanisms, orchestrates a pipeline, and handles client connections for a WebRTC or similar real-time communication scenario.

classes.name: AICFilter
classes.description: A class responsible for filtering audio input with enhancement features.

classes.name: DailyParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for daily transportation audio setup.

classes.name: FastAPIWebsocketParams
classes.description: Configuration for FastAPI WebSocket transport with audio and VAD settings.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Holds the message history and state for the language model interactions.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Manages aggregation of user input and assistant responses in the conversation context.

classes.name: LLMUserAggregatorParams
classes.description: Parameters for user-specific message aggregation strategies.

classes.name: UserTurnStrategies
classes.description: Encapsulates strategies for handling user turns, including stop conditions.

classes.name: TurnAnalyzerUserTurnStopStrategy
classes.description: Defines when to stop a user's turn based on analyzing the turn.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the sequence of processing steps for the conversation.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Represents an executable task based on a pipeline.

classes.name: LLMRunFrame
classes.description: Frame used to trigger a run of the language model within the pipeline.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Handles execution and management of the processing pipeline.

methods.name: AICFilter _create_aic_filter()
methods.description: Constructs an AICFilter object with credentials from environment variables.

methods.name: run_bot(transport: BaseTransport, runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Sets up and initiates the bot's main processing loop, including transport, pipeline, and event handlers.

methods.name: bot(runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Main entry point to create transport and start the bot asynchronously.

ctags.name: on_audio_data
ctags.pattern: /^    async def on_audio_data(buffer, audio, sample_rate, num_channels):$/
